episodes.title: i was in a youth group cult | STORYTIME
episodes.description:
follow me on ig www.instagram.com/melodyplease101 💗

I grew up as a pastor’s kid in an Assemblies of God church, and what started as a seemingly normal church youth group eventually turned into an experience that I can only describe as….. a mf cult. I’m sharing my personal experience, the things I witnessed, and how growing up in that environment shaped my perspective on religion, church, and faith.
